post.description: Atomically materialize a versioned capability definition as skills, one expert, or an expert team in the workspace. Requires workspace membership; runtime bindings must name runtimes in the workspace that the caller may use (private runtimes need their owner or a workspace admin). Skill-only definitions need no bindings. The body is decoded strictly (unknown fields are rejected) and limited to 32 MiB. Replaying an identical Idempotency-Key and body within 24 hours returns the original result. Task credentials are rejected; issued Loop credentials need the capability.install action. This route always uses the public contract.

429.description: RATE_LIMITED - capability installation rate exceeded the configured limit.

409.description: DUPLICATE - the Idempotency-Key was reused with a different request, an expert name already exists, or a caller-owned same-name skill has different content.

413.description: PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE - the body exceeds 32 MiB or a definition limit.

503.description: UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE - a required verifier or identity store is unavailable.

200.description: Capability resources were created, or the original result was replayed.

get.description: Read workspace members through Fleet. For Octo Project workspaces Fleet verifies the caller's Project access, including its configured verified Bot-owner fallback, then forwards the internally authenticated Server member-list response. The caller remains the Bot. Supply the Project UUID positionally or with --workspace-id. Use page/page_size pagination; CLI JSON exposes the member array as .data[] but does not expose the upstream X-Total-Count header, so continue until a page is shorter than page_size. Legacy limit/offset flags are translated when offset is a multiple of the page size. Legacy workspaces retain their native Fleet member array.

parameters.name: workspace_id
parameters.description: Octo Project UUID, shared with the Loop workspace identity.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Maximum Project members returned per page (1-200).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Compatibility alias for --page-size; translated before the request.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Compatibility offset; must be a multiple of the effective page size (default 50) and cannot be combined with --page. The CLI sends that page size with the translated page.

200.description: Member array forwarded by Fleet after authorization. Project member total is in X-Total-Count.

uid.description: Opaque, case-sensitive Octo user UID. Use assignee_octo_uid when assigning a human Project member.

role.description: Project role: 0 common member, 1 admin, 2 owner.

robot.description: 0 for a person, 1 for a Bot. Bot seats remain visible in member listings.

octo_uid.description: Legacy user's Octo UID when available.

post.description: Add a member to a legacy workspace. Requires the workspace owner or admin role; project workspaces return 409. The request mode is chosen by its fields: principal_type and principal_id add a same-Space Octo user or bot directly (the principal must be on the Space roster and its type must match; requires Octo authentication and returns 200), while email creates a pending email invitation (returns 201). Email and principal fields cannot be combined. When sent, X-Workspace-ID must equal workspace_id.

principal_type.description: Principal mode: Octo principal type; must match the Space roster entry.

principal_id.description: Principal mode: Octo uid of the user or bot.

role.description: Member role; owner is rejected. Defaults to member.
Member role; owner is rejected. Defaults to member.
Member role; owner is rejected. Defaults to member.

409.description: CONFLICT - the workspace is a project workspace whose membership is managed by octo-server, the user is already a member, an invitation is already pending, or the Octo identity exists with a different principal type.

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE - Octo integration is not configured or the Space roster lookup failed.

200.description: Principal member added (principal mode); body is the member without a data envelope.

201.description: Invitation created (email mode); body is the invitation without a data envelope.

post.description: Record the expert team leader's evaluation outcome for the current execution of the task. The task must be assigned to an expert team, the caller must act as that team's leader expert, and the X-Task-ID execution must belong to the task (task credentials supply it automatically). Task-credential only: a Bot token cannot use this operation, because the CLI never sends caller-supplied X-Agent-ID or X-Task-ID headers, so a Bot call is rejected with 403.

TaskCreatorOctoUIDs.name: creator_octo_uids

TaskDateField.description: Timestamp field selected by the date range; supply with date_start and date_end.

TaskDateStart.description: Inclusive RFC3339 timestamp starting the selected date range; supply all three date filters together.

TaskDateEnd.name: date_end

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
